fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (MRVL) is ahead of its earnings announcement on December 1st, with the current quarter's revenue of $320 million and annual growth of over 50% already reflected in the stock price.
fields.summary_ko.1: MRVL faces investor skepticism over the Lumentum acquisition ($11.5 billion enterprise value), and year-end Federal Reserve rate hikes could negatively impact tech stocks, making it necessary to review buying after earnings.
